CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is the national flag flown at national athletics events? (1 mark)
   A. It shows which country the athletes represent and builds pride
   B. To block the wind
   C. To decorate only
   D. To hide the track

2. How should we treat the national flag? (1 mark)
   A. With care and respect, never letting it touch the ground
   B. Use it as a rag
   C. Write on it
   D. Throw it around

3. What is patriotism? (1 mark)
   A. Fear of runners
   B. A kind of race
   C. Love for one's country
   D. Love of food

4. A relay race is a race in which (1 mark)
   A. people jump into sand
   B. team members take turns running and pass a baton
   C. one person runs all the way
   D. people throw a ball

5. In a crab balance, your fingers point (1 mark)
   A. towards your feet
   B. behind your back
   C. up to the sky
   D. away from your feet

6. Which is the correct first step in the crab balance? (1 mark)
   A. Stand on your head
   B. Jump high
   C. Lie face down
   D. Sit with knees bent and feet flat

7. A balance in gymnastics is (1 mark)
   A. a jump into water
   B. a throw
   C. a fast run
   D. a position held still for a few seconds

8. Which health benefit comes from gymnastics? (1 mark)
   A. Slower breathing always
   B. Better flexibility
   C. Less energy
   D. Weaker bones

9. Unison singing is suitable for an anthem because (1 mark)
   A. it needs instruments
   B. it uses no notes
   C. everyone can join in the same tune
   D. it is silent

10. Singing in unison means (1 mark)
   A. everyone sings different tunes
   B. only one sings
   C. nobody sings
   D. everyone sings the same notes at the same time

11. Which is a patriotic song? (1 mark)
   A. A hymn of worship only
   B. A drum solo
   C. Kenya National Anthem
   D. A lullaby about sleeping

12. Gestures in singing are (1 mark)
   A. sounds of the drum
   B. hand and body movements that fit the song
   C. words only
   D. quiet time

13. The battery of a camera (1 mark)
   A. takes the photo
   B. gives it power
   C. cleans the lens
   D. keeps it dry

14. Which photo should be kept? (1 mark)
   A. One taken by accident
   B. One with good light and a clear centre of interest
   C. One with a finger on the lens
   D. One that is dark and blurred

15. Where must you never take photographs? (1 mark)
   A. In the classroom with permission
   B. At the school gate
   C. In the playground with permission
   D. In private places such as toilets

16. Why use a camera strap? (1 mark)
   A. To keep it wet
   B. To cover the lens
   C. To make it heavy
   D. So the camera does not drop

17. Why should recorders not be shared without cleaning? (1 mark)
   A. They change colour
   B. Germs can spread through the mouthpiece
   C. They melt
   D. They become heavy

18. Where should a recorder be stored? (1 mark)
   A. On a hot windowsill
   B. In the mud
   C. Under a heavy load
   D. In its bag or box

19. How many lines are on a staff? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Ten
   C. Four
   D. Three

20. Uncovering holes makes the note (1 mark)
   A. lower
   B. higher
   C. the same
   D. silent

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give three reasons for flying the Kenyan flag at an athletics event. (3 marks)

22. State four performance techniques for a good singer. (4 marks)

23. How do you select the best photographs? (3 marks)

24. Describe the correct posture and hand position for playing the recorder. (4 marks)

25. Name two types of songs learnt in this topic other than folk songs. (2 marks)

26. How can you show the mood of a joyful song when singing? (3 marks)

27. Give three examples of good etiquette during a performance. (3 marks)

28. Describe how to get into a crab balance. (4 marks)

29. Name two digital devices used for taking photographs. (2 marks)

30. Why should the flag stick be held high while cheering? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — It shows which country the athletes represent and builds pride
   The flag is a symbol of the country.

2. A — With care and respect, never letting it touch the ground
   Respect for the flag means caring for it.

3. C — Love for one's country
   Patriotism is love and respect for one's country.

4. B — team members take turns running and pass a baton
   In a relay, runners pass a baton to the next teammate.

5. A — towards your feet
   In the crab position, hands are behind you with fingers pointing to the feet.

6. D — Sit with knees bent and feet flat
   You start sitting with knees bent and feet flat.

7. D — a position held still for a few seconds
   A balance is a still position that you hold under control.

8. B — Better flexibility
   Stretching and rolling help joints and muscles bend freely.

9. C — everyone can join in the same tune
   A single tune that everybody sings is simple and strong.

10. D — everyone sings the same notes at the same time
   Unison means the same notes together.

11. C — Kenya National Anthem
   The anthem is a patriotic song.

12. B — hand and body movements that fit the song
   Gestures help tell the story of a song.

13. B — gives it power
   Without power the device will not work.

14. B — One with good light and a clear centre of interest
   Good photographs are well lit and clear.

15. D — In private places such as toilets
   Privacy must be respected.

16. D — So the camera does not drop
   A strap protects the device from falls.

17. B — Germs can spread through the mouthpiece
   Saliva can carry disease-causing germs.

18. D — In its bag or box
   A case protects it.

19. A — Five
   The staff has five lines.

20. B — higher
   Shorter air column means a higher note.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: It shows which country the athletes represent; it builds pride and patriotism; it brings people together to cheer; it shows respect to visitors. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: Good posture; deep breathing; clear diction; gestures; facial expression; eye contact. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Check for good light, a clear subject, sharpness and no distractions, and delete the poor ones.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sit or stand tall. Hold the recorder pointing down and away. The left hand is at the top and the right hand at the bottom. The left thumb covers the thumb hole and fingers cover holes with the pads.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Sacred songs, patriotic songs and topical songs. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Smile, use lively gestures, sing brightly and at a lively tempo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Walk on and off quietly, listen to the leader, do not talk or laugh, clap for others, bow at the end. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sit with knees bent and feet flat. Put hands behind you shoulder-width apart with fingers pointing to the feet. Push through hands and feet to lift the hips so the body is level. Hold for a few counts.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Smartphone, tablet, digital camera. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: So it does not hit other people, and so the flag can be seen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.
